en: An old, sepia-toned photograph shows a busy town square with people walking and a horse-drawn carriage. On the left is a large, ornate building with columns and a dome, possibly a theater or town hall. On the right is a two-story building with an arched sign in Cyrillic script above the entrance. Several trees line the square, and people are scattered throughout the scene, including a child standing in the foreground. The lower part of the postcard contains handwritten text in Cyrillic.
